notes.title: Steam Deck Update! :D
notes.notes:
Hi all! Success! The title has been updated to Unreal engine 5 and I took this opportunity to completely overhaul the controller support for a nice, smooth experience on this lovely new handheld we've got.

Performance wise, MENOS already ran great on deck but controller support, while functional, wasn't very fun. 

The new configuration makes the transition between Telekinesis and Gunfighting way more seamless, makes navigating menus a lot easier and cleans up any cursor tracking issues I noticed on the previous version.

The Update to Unreal Engine 5 took a lot more work than I initially though it would (go figure) so I hope you enjoy the new and improved performance and pad support whether you game on deck or on the couch. 

Hopefully, the title will one day be Verified on deck but for now you'll just have to take my word for it ;)

Work on the Sequel, MENOS: PRECURSOR is coming along really well, hoping to launch a new and improved demo for the title in the coming months so stay tuned!

As always, thanks so much for playing, I hope you enjoy your time with MENOS!

-Jack

notes.title: Announcing MENOS: PRECURSOR
notes.notes:
Hi everyone, the release of Unreal Engine 5 has been extremely cool and I'm happy to announce that I've been working on a [b]sequel[/b]! 

[b]MENOS: PRECURSOR[/b] will see a perspective shift to third person, an expanded story and more powers.

Check out the teaser trailer:

[previewyoutube=ixlsgz8K-tM;full][/previewyoutube]  

I'm currently working on a public demo for [b]Steam Next Fest[/b] and I'm really excited to work on this project.

In other news, during the prototyping for Precursor, I've found some solutions for issues that arose in the original title, Psi-Shatter. I'll be implementing these fixes along with some other improvements in the coming weeks as well as porting Psi-Shatter to Unreal Engine 5 in preparation for the sequel!

[b]Add Precursor to your Wishlist below![/b]

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1965440/MENOS_PRECURSOR/]MENOS: PRECURSOR[/url]

Thank you for your time, 

-Jack

notes.title: A few small tweaks and a nice package. Yes.
notes.notes:
Hello!

I've just uploaded a patch to tweak a couple of things:

- Walking toggle has been removed.
- Slow-mo time on death has been reduced from 0.5 seconds to 0.2 seconds.
- I've implemented some further packaging optimization for the game that reduces install size from around 600mb to around 350mb. 

You now have more room on your hard drive for Warzone skins.

I've also added a little request next to the quit game button, MENOS has been received really well (100% positive reviews at the time of writing! What!) but in the time since it's release it's failed to accrue enough reviews to generate an average score. Positive or Negative, please consider leaving me a review so that I may satisfy the all powerful algorithm and improve as a developer.

You're the best, thanks for buying my game.

-Jack

notes.title: Laser sight added for shooting.
notes.notes:
I've added a lazer sight to weapons to assist with aiming in the transition from using the target for Telekinesis and shooting, see pictured.
This should particularly help controller players.

Let me know if there are any other tweaks you'd like to see.

-Jack

notes.title: Post launch updates / balancing.
notes.notes:
Hi everyone, in the couple of days since launch I've made several incremental updates based on player feedback and gone in to fix bugs that have arisen.

You can read up on them on the Recent Updates page here:
https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1602350?updates=true

Thanks again for playing,

-Jack

notes.title: Balancing update.
notes.notes:
-Enemies now only shoot when on screen.
-The range at which enemies can shoot is greatly increased, they can now shoot back when you're firing from a greater distance using the ALT/RB zoom but again, only when they're on screen.
-Improvements to the TK grab's effectiveness.

notes.title: Quick patch o'clock
notes.notes:
UPDATE: Also fixed the issue with enemies sometimes not taking damage from hitting the environment. 

Hi everyone, thanks a ton for checking out MENOS. I've noticed some people are having a little trouble grabbing enemies when they're charging at you so I've gone ahead and updated the enemies to run ever so slightly slower while also increasing the area of effect on the Telekinesis grab. 

Hopefully that sorts out any issues you may have been having.

If there's anything else come and shout at me on the forums and I'll get right on it. 

Thanks a million and have a good one.

-Jack
